items.title: MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations
items.summary: Hospitality and casino entertainment company MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1% year on year to $4.45 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.59 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
